roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Discounting Platform
roles.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Senior Product Manager, Discounting Platform

Job #PMDP39

Overview

Maplebear Inc. D/B/A Instacart in San Francisco, CA seeks Senior Product Manager, Discounting Platform (Multiple Openings). Employee may be stationed anywhere in the continental United States but will report directly to Instacart headquarters in San Francisco, CA.

About the Job

Lead the design and execution of innovative technical and analytical solutions to optimize and scale world-class e-commerce products with a focus on the strategic vision for promotional systems that drive customer acquisition and retention.

Duties include:

Analyzing business goals, market needs, and technical requirements to develop product roadmaps and key metrics for discounting features

Analyzing redemption rates, ROI, and other metrics to optimize performance

Planning and executing product research, usability studies, and functional experiments to identify areas for improvement, forecast results, and inform product direction

Designing self-service tools and scalable integrations to assist business partners in providing more offerings to customers; working cross-functionally with engineering, data science, and marketing to launch new promotional capabilities

Other duties as assigned.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Marketing Analytics, or related field (or foreign equivalent)

2 years of experience in the job offered or related

2 years of product management experience overseeing roadmap strategy, definition, and end-to-end product delivery and negotiating tradeoffs

2 years of experience working with cross-functional teams to identify new roadmap opportunities and software product improvements

2 years of designing and developing large-scale software products in deeply technical domains

2 years of experience developing metrics and KPIs to measure product performance

2 years of experience executing and analyzing user research, usability studies, and data-driven experiments

2 years of experience using SQL or similar analytical tools to develop data-driven recommendations for product development

2 years of experience working with APIs, microservices, and web application technologies

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Connectivity Platform
roles.description:
BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to own Wealthsimple’s Connectivity Platform, spanning two critical areas:

- Brokerage & Bank Linking: How clients securely and reliably connect external financial institutions to Wealthsimple.

- Public API: How clients and partners securely access and use Wealthsimple financial data outside of Wealthsimple.

Together, these capabilities define how Wealthsimple connects to the broader financial ecosystem, and how every product team inside Wealthsimple builds on the external financial data that flows through it. This role will set the strategy for that platform and turn it into a reliable, scalable and differentiated capability for our clients, our product teams and our partners.

This is a platform role with a meaningful client experience surface. You’ll need to be equally comfortable thinking about APIs, data models and platform architecture as you are designing a client UX or deciding how Wealthsimple should work with an external provider.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Brokerage & Bank Linking team builds the technology that lets clients link their outside bank and brokerage accounts to Wealthsimple. It owns the automated and manual linking experiences end to end, along with the three connectors behind them: Plaid, Flinks, and WST, our own in-house connector. That makes it one of the highest leverage surfaces in the company, and powers a growing set of experiences built by other product teams.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Connectivity Strategy

- Set the long term vision and strategy for how Wealthsimple connects with the broader financial ecosystem.

- Define the capabilities we should build ourselves, where we should rely on partners, and where we can create differentiated client value.

- Develop a roadmap that balances immediate product needs with investments in reusable platform capabilities.

Brokerage & Bank Linking

- Own the end to end experience for connecting external bank and brokerage accounts to Wealthsimple — automated and manual, including how clients recover when an automated connection fails.

- Improve connection success, reliability and coverage across institutions, and own the routing strategy that decides which connector handles which institution and flow.

- Own the client experience, including institution selection, authentication, errors, recovery and connection management.

- Drive reliability and AI Powered self-healing so connections detect and recover from failure without manual intervention.

- Balance conversion against fraud exposure and operational load, making those tradeoffs deliberately with our risk and operations partners.

- Develop the platform capabilities that allow Wealthsimple products to consume external financial data consistently.

- Own relationships and product integrations with connectivity vendors such as Plaid and Flinks, and decide where our own connector should lead — including how much of the connector business Wealthsimple should be in long term and where it makes more sense to partner.

Public API

- Own the strategy and roadmap for Wealthsimple’s Public API and external data connectivity.

- Make it safe and easy for clients to permission their Wealthsimple financial data to the products and services they choose.

- Define the platform capabilities required for authentication, consent, permissions, data access and partner integrations.

- Identify and prioritize the partners and use cases that matter most to Wealthsimple clients.

- Build toward a world where Wealthsimple is the financial institution where clients have the most control over their financial data.

- Accelerate wealthsimple and our industry toward open banking.

SKILLS YOU BRING

You’re a strong product thinker who can operate across platform infrastructure, external ecosystems and client experience. You likely have:

- Experience owning a platform, API, developer product or integrations platform, with a track record on metric-attached outcomes like conversion, success rate or reliability — not only feature delivery.

- Enough technical depth to work closely with engineers on APIs, authentication, data models, routing and platform architecture.

- Experience delivering through external vendors or partners whose roadmaps you don’t control, including making thoughtful build versus buy decisions and holding vendors accountable for product outcomes.

- Comfort treating reliability as product work — error taxonomies, failure recovery, observability, and the operational load a product creates.

- Experience weighing growth against fraud, risk and compliance, and holding both sides of that tradeoff.

- The ability to turn a collection of technical capabilities into a clear product strategy and compelling long term vision, and to make the case for investing in it.

- Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to understand reliability, conversion, coverage and product performance, including building the measurement where it doesn’t exist yet.

- Excellent cross functional leadership across Engineering, Design, Security, Legal, Compliance, Operations and external partners.

- A bias toward simplifying complicated systems rather than layering more complexity on top of them.

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience with open banking, Canada’s consumer-driven banking framework, or building to a data sharing standard

- A background in financial data aggregation, whether at an aggregator, a bank, or a fintech consuming one

- Experience shipping a public API or developer platform as a commercial product, including partner onboarding and support

WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

You won’t just operate Bank Linking and ship API endpoints.

You’ll create a coherent connectivity strategy for Wealthsimple: making it easier for clients to bring their financial life to Wealthsimple, easier to move their financial data where they want it to go, easier for any team at Wealthsimple to build on that data, and increasingly less dependent on the slow pace of connectivity innovation from incumbent financial institutions.

You’ll also have made the case for what this platform should become — the metrics, the roadmap and the investment argument that get it there.

WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.

Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.

AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.
